scope: Read-only pure-boundary review. Repository and all earlier uncommitted reports are preserved; no source or test edits.
verifiedBoundaries: Exact own data descriptors are captured for origin/proposal, while the original strict directory capture owns scene/instance/assembly/action DTO validation and nested array bounds.
Creation origin strictly pins world ID, base revision, scene object ID, object revision, source path and source revision. Directory world/revision/scene source must match before independent branding.

A separate WeakMap creates first-creation identity. Raw, serialized, shallow-copy and old saved-manifest brands cannot directly propose a first-creation insertion; first-creation brands also cannot call the old saved-source value helper.
Only existing scalar String fields may be selected. Numeric/boolean fields and implicit parameter creation are refused; no parameter-name inference or navigation policy is introduced.
The chosen value must exist in the captured instance list or the explicitly selected assembly member/action list; shared definition UUIDs do not replace instance UUIDs.

Both input and output parameter JSON are validated through the existing first-creation scalar/UTF-8/full-manifest budget authority. Same-value no-op still validates input and preserves escaped lexemes.

Replacement uses an exact UTF-16 JSON Pointer value span; surrounding BOM/CRLF/nonBMP/escapes/numeric lexemes remain unchanged. Output contains only a frozen ordinary content/changed record, with no I/O or persistence grant.

cases: Corrupt or unnormalized origin+directory paths reject
Nested accessors/decorated arrays including newline action reject with0getter calls
Boxed inputs and proposal getters never coerce or execute
No-op still rejects unrelated invalid scalar content while retaining valid escaped bytes
A valid input at exact full-manifest budget refuses a growing replacement
Old saved-manifest and creation brands are disjoint in both directions

Final creation must continue through strict identity-only planner, separate fragment embedding and ordinary behavior.create validation; no hidden source relation or write authority is added.
